Caution: Equipment Damage Hazard Do not operate the cooling system if the outdoor temperature is below 50˚F (10˚ C) to prevent possible compressor damage. Do not mount or place remote sensors in these locations: • Close to hot or cold air ducts • That are in direct sunlight • With an outside wall behind the thermostat • In areas that do not require conditioning • Where there are dead spots or drafts (in corners or behind doors) • Where appliances could radiate heat. • Near or on hot appliances.
